summary: Fiserv Inc filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) offering €500M 3.750% Senior Notes due 2030 and €500M 4.250% Senior Notes due 2034, totaling €1B. Proceeds, with commercial paper and cash, will fund a concurrent tender offer for $750M of 5.150% notes due 2027 and $2B of 4.400% notes due 2049. The new notes are unsecured senior obligations ranking equally with other unsecured senior debt. They are issued in Euroclear/Clearstream book-entry form, minimum €100,000 denominations. Listing on NASDAQ is intended but not guaranteed. This is a routine financing and liability management transaction, not a special situation.
